title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! Here's your NYC Daily Digest for Thursday, November 12, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
• Now: mild and gray. Showers start this morning and turn into steadier rain later today, with a chance of a thunderstorm.
• High 59–61°F, low 41–43°F
• Rain chance: about 100%, roughly half an inch, with some heavy downpours possible
• What to wear/bring: a sturdy umbrella, a rain jacket and waterproof shoes. Expect puddles at the curb.

🗞️ Headlines
• Brooklyn building collapse: At least 8 people are dead after a 3-story building near a construction site came down Wednesday afternoon, according to Mayor Mamdani. 17 or more were hospitalized, 4 of them in critical condition. A pregnant woman was pulled alive from the rubble overnight, and the search goes on as the storm moves in.
• NVIDIA: The WSJ reports the board may be preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, and shares were down about 5.5% before the market opened.
• Middle East: Oil prices eased on reports that VP Vance may meet a top Iranian official. Iran's Revolutionary Guard says explosions hit two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
• UK: British authorities arrested a senior US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia.
• Europe: Storm Charles has closed schools across Portugal, and a general strike in Spain led to clashes in Barcelona.

🚇 Getting around
• A train: No service between Rockaway Blvd and Ozone Park–Lefferts Blvd until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov 16, because of switch work. Lefferts-branch trains are rerouted to Howard Beach–JFK.
• The rain could slow things down on all lines and around Brooklyn streets near the collapse site. Check the MYmta app before you leave.

🎉 NYC today
• The New York Comedy Festival runs through Sunday, Nov 15, with shows across the city tonight. It's a good indoor plan for a rainy evening.
• Rainy-day tip: museums and the Comedy Festival are your friends today.

💡 Nugget
Forecasters say Friday brings the coldest air of the season so far, so get your warm coat out tonight. Tomorrow morning will feel much colder than today.
